Interface VirtualServer

All Known Subinterfaces:
VirtualServerRmi, VirtualServerSocket
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClient, RmiServer, SocketServerHandler
public interface VirtualServer
Interface representing the server infrastructure as exposed to remote clients. It outlines the actions a connected client can invoke on the server to manage games and execute gameplay interactions.

  • Method Details

    • createGame

      void createGame(String nickname, int numPlayers, String totemColor) throws Exception
      Requests the creation of a new game session on the server.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the requested username of the player hosting the game.
      numPlayers - the desired number of participants for the match.
      totemColor - the preferred totem color of the host.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the network transaction fails or validation errors occur.

    • joinGame

      void joinGame(String nickname, int gameId, String totemColor) throws Exception
      Requests a connection to a specific, existing game session.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the requested username of the player joining the match.
      gameId - the unique numerical identifier of the target game.
      totemColor - the preferred totem color of the joining player.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the connection fails or if the game is full/unavailable.

    • placeTotem

      void placeTotem(String nickname, char position) throws Exception
      Submits a gameplay request to place a totem at a precise coordinate.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the username of the active player performing the action.
      position - the character representing the chosen board position.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the network transaction fails or the move proves invalid.

    • pickCard

      void pickCard(String nickname, int cardId, int row) throws Exception
      Submits a gameplay request to pick a specific card from the available selections.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the username of the active player picking the card.
      cardId - the unique identifier of the chosen card.
      row - a value representing the row, deck, or context from which the card is drawn.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the network transaction fails or the action is denied.

    • pingServer

      Thread pingServer(String nickname) throws RemoteException
      Reaches out to the server with a keep-alive ping to maintain the connection.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the username of the client communicating its heartbeat.
      Returns:
      the Thread operating the connection/ping management, depending on the network protocol in use.
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if an RMI-related network error manifests during the ping.
